# ProVizion Outsourcing

> Philippines outsourcing company building dedicated customer service, technical support and back office teams for US, Australian, UK and Canadian businesses since 2011.

ProVizion Outsourcing (Provizion Marketing Services t/a ProVizion Outsourcing) is based in Manila. We employ full-time Filipino staff who work inside the client's own systems on the client's hours. We do not run shared-pool call centre work. Teams from one seat to about twenty are employed directly by us; larger programmes use partner centres while we remain the single point of contact.

Typical start: one to three person teams can be live in 48 hours. Larger programmes take a few weeks. Engagements are usually three to twelve months. Clients have included Allstate, Alibaba Group, Keller Williams, Hewlett Packard, Acrisure, Transcosmos, USHEALTH Group and Anytime Fitness.

Book a call: https://provizionoutsourcing.com/book
Request a proposal: https://provizionoutsourcing.com/rfp
Contact: https://provizionoutsourcing.com/contact
